programme.title: Andromeda: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programme.desc: Der gøres et forsøg på at reparere Seefras blinkende sol, men Trance erstattes af en dobbeltgænger.
programme.sub-title: Saving Light From a Black Sun

programme.title: Andromeda: Samlet tilbagekaldelse
programme.desc: Da Dylan bliver alvorligt såret i en laboratorieeksplosion, rejser han gennem en række alternative virkeligheder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Quantum Tractate Delirium
programme.desc: Rommie bliver genopbygget for at hjælpe med at evakuere Seefra-systemet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Endnu en dags lys
programme.desc: En krigsherre overbeviser sine tilhængere om, at den forestående ødelæggelse af de ydre planeter er et komplot, der skal gøre det lettere for dem at plyndre deres planet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kaos og stilheden i det
programme.desc: Dylan, Rhade og Beka arbejder sammen for at redde Trance fra Methus-2 og Harper fra general Burma.

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 1)
programme.desc: Besætningen når endelig ud af Seefra-systemet og opdager, at Dylan er den sidste Paradine

programme.title: Andromeda: Rejsens hjerte (del 2)
programme.desc: Den endelige kamp for at redde det nye systemers Commonwealth begynder.

programme.title: Andromeda: Under the Night
programme.desc: Efter at være strandet nær et sort hul bliver kaptajn Dylan Hunt opdaget af et bjærgningsskib og finder ud af, at han har været frosset i tiden i 300 år.

programme.title: Andromeda: En bekræftende flamme
programme.desc: Dylan beskytter Andromeda mod lejesoldater, mens Beka begynder at spekulere på, om de kæmper for den forkerte side.

programme.title: Andromeda: At miste det skæbnesvangre lyn
programme.desc: Dylan finder en rumstation fuld af børn, som tror, at han er der for at skabe fred ved at dræbe deres fjender.

programme.title: Andromeda: D Minus Zero
programme.desc: Andromeda-besætningen er stadig ved at lære at arbejde sammen, da de bliver angrebet af Restorers.

programme.title: Andromeda: Double Helix
programme.desc: Andromeda bliver involveret i en fejde mellem en Than-planet og en nietzscheansk koloni.

programme.title: Andromeda: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon
programme.desc: En slipstream sender Andromeda tilbage i tiden til lige før Commonwealths fald. Besætningen må gribe ind for at bevare historien.
programme.sub-title: En mørk engel, en lysende dæmon

programme.title: Andromeda: Båndene der blinder
programme.desc: Besætningen besvarer et nødopkald og samler Beckas bror, som nu er Wayist, og hans ven op.

programme.title: Andromeda: En ufuldkommenhedens symmetri
programme.desc: Når Rommie bliver for følelsesladet, afskærer skibet hendes adgang til at udføre diagnostik.

programme.title: Andromeda: Tid uden for sindet
programme.desc: Abyss dræber Beckas ven, og besætningen må finde ud af, hvilke oplysninger de dræbte for at få fat i.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det dissonante interval (del 1)
programme.desc: Andromeda redder et skib, der vender tilbage fra fredsforhandlinger med Magog.

programme.title: Andromeda: Det dissonante interval (del 2)
programme.desc: Magog-angrebet har alvorlige konsekvenser. Andromeda bliver ødelagt, Trance og Dylan formodes at være de eneste overlevende, og Dylan flygter ud i tidernes rute

programme.title: Andromeda: Vægten (del 1)
programme.desc: Dylan ender på Seefra, hvor den overtroiske befolkning ikke har nogen teknologi.

programme.title: Andromeda: Vægten (del 2)
programme.desc: Beka bliver dumpet på Seefra, efter at Andromeda er blevet stjålet, og Dylan skal bevise, at skibet er hans.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Concrete Alibi
programme.desc: An aspiring model turned up dead and the prime suspect was her boyfriend. When he was eventually cleared, investigators had to dig deeper to find the perpetrator. With the help of a forensic geologist, they identified the most unlikely suspects.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Key Evidence
programme.desc: When an off-duty policeman was shot dead, his fellow officers were determined to solve the crime. They needed clues to find the killer and they discovered them in tiny fibres and an asthma inhaler.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Gambler
programme.desc: One warm summer afternoon, the town of Verona, Wisconsin faced its first triple homicide. To solve the case, investigators had to delve into the world of high rollers and offshore betting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Weakest Link
programme.desc: The body of a young girl was discovered on isolated farmland near Delano, California. She had no ID, but police found mailbox keys in the pocket of her jeans. With no other clues, they checked the mailboxes of every apartment building in Delano.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Capitol Crimes
programme.desc: The driver said he couldn't have hit and killed a pedestrian on a Harrisburg street. The Jeep Grand Cherokee he was leasing around that time had been sold months ago to a buyer in another state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Undertaken
programme.desc: The medical examiner ruled the death an accident, but the detectives investigating the case thought the evidence at the scene indicated otherwise.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dark Waters
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run boating accident caused the death of a popular young man, investigators faced the daunting task of searching for one boat among 1200 others.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Nice Threads
programme.desc: A woman was found dead on the bedroom floor of her apartment. The crime scene yielded little of value and investigators wondered if they would find enough evidence to make a case, much less catch a killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Grave Danger
programme.desc: A young man was killed in a mysterious car crash, but the evidence at the scene led investigators to believe it was not an accident. Forensic science revealed what really happened and the truth devastated three families.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Internal Affair
programme.desc: When a woman went missing, friends and family were determined to find her. Their worst fears were confirmed weeks later when her body was discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Case of the Flue
programme.desc: In 1993, 82-year-old Kathryn Bishop was found dead in her Pennsylvania home. Tiny clues on the victim's body would tell police what happened that night.

programme.title: Forensic Files: No Safe Place
programme.desc: A wealthy man and his wife were attacked by three masked men outside their luxurious Louisiana home. He was shot dead and she was forced to open their hidden safe. To solve the crime, police would have to find out who knew about the concealed safe.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Live Wire
programme.desc: A bomb, constructed to cause as much damage as possible, kills a victim with deadly force and flame. When a painstaking search yields some tiny clues, police are able to identify the killer as surely as if he'd signed them.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Van-ished
programme.desc: A twelve-year-old girl claimed she had been abducted and sexually assaulted. She recounted what happened in such a flat, unemotional voice that police found it difficult to believe her. Fibers on her clothing would prove she was telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Novel Idea
programme.desc: When the number and volume of bloodstains at the scene was greater than usual, it was up to forensic scientists to find out why.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Water Hazard
programme.desc: The victim had ingested a massive amount of cyanide. An unlikely clue ? a flaw on a mailing envelope ? exposed a murderer who was willing to kill innocent people.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shell Game
programme.desc: They thought the fire would cover their crime. But one tiny clue, no bigger than a thumbtack, remained. It held all the information investigators needed to put a trio of cold-blooded killers behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ring Him Up
programme.desc: In 1994, 19-year-old Shannon Melendi disappeared while at Emory University. Her disappearance remained a mystery for ten years, until new scientific testing cast a different light on Colvin "Butch" Hinton.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Killer Impression
programme.desc: In 1987, the death of Crystal Purcell was considered an accident. Then in 2001, Barbara Purcell called police to suggest that her estranged husband had killed Crystal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: If I Were You
programme.desc: Paul Gruber's daughter suspected something was wrong when she received birthday cards addressed from her father, but written in a stranger's handwriting.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As the Tide Turns
programme.desc: The woman was dead. The man had been shot four times and survived. When the man's version of events contradicted physical evidence, investigators turned to forensic science to paint a clearer picture of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Tight Leash
programme.desc: How did the stalker obtain the security system code for his victim's home? How did he steal her personal photographs? Police needed answers and they found them in the most unlikely of places.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Muffled Cries
programme.desc: After inspecting storm damage to a home in Tampa, an insurance assessor simply disappeared. Thirty hours later, her body was found in a nearby river. But the killer had been careless.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Critical Maneuver
programme.desc: When a hit-and-run accident claimed the life of a high school athlete, everyone in town mourned his passing. Finding the killer was a long shot at best.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Skirting the Evidence
programme.desc: A murder trail turned cold, until police got a call from a woman whose husband, Gerald Powers, had a criminal past and a fondness for Chevy Berettas.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In 1991, Grand Junction, Colorado is on edge after a series of deadly bombings kill two people and injure one more. Police race to find the culprit before he strikes again.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Ticker Tape
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Step by Step
programme.desc: When a wealthy socialite died after falling down the stairs, witness accounts contradicted evidence. To find out what really happened, investigators employed a physicist and an expert in accident reconstruction.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Blanket of Evidence
programme.desc: In 1997, Kelly Eckart's car was found, with her belongings still in it, after she worked a late shift in Franklin, Indiana. Days later, her body was found in an isolated ravine.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fired-Up
programme.desc: In 1996, Derrick Duehren returned to find his Oregon home burned to the ground. His wife's charred remains were later found in the rubble. Investigators set out to determine if it was an unfortunate accident or murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A millionaire and his family were executed in their own home. For three years, the murders went unsolved. Finally, a 30-year-old box of ammunition and some fluorescent fibers revealed the ultimate betrayal.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sharper Image
programme.desc: When a young girl was found dead, police quickly arrested the most likely suspect. But cutting-edge technology from NASA enabled a forensic odontologist to prove the wrong man was behind bars.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insulated Evidence
programme.desc: It's usually easy to determine how a criminal entered the crime scene. But in this case, it looked as if the killer vanished into thin air ? and perhaps he had.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Hearted
programme.desc: When a young fireman died from what appeared to be serious but undiagnosed heart disease, his family and friends had no proof of foul play.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Wheel of Misfortune
programme.desc: Casino security cameras tracked a young woman's movements until shortly before she disappeared. She was never seen again, but through the evidence she left behind, she was able to tell investigators what happened to her and who was responsible.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cracking The Cartel
programme.desc: A mother and child are kidnapped a bystander is murdered. Violence such as this shattered a quiet Texas neighborhood and exposed a drug cartel that flourished where it was least expected.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Stranger in Town
programme.desc: She appeared on the highway in the spring, a young woman, her life cut short, her past and her identity a mystery. Only by finding out who she was could we ever hope to find her killer.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hunter's Game
programme.desc: In the 1970s and 80s, people went to Alaska looking for a fresh start, to reinvent themselves, or to disappear for a while. Some of those disappearances weren't by choice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: False Witness
programme.desc: When a murder is committed and deceit clouds the evidence, investigators turn to science and technology to uncover the truth and expose a murderous lie and capture the killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Missing
programme.desc: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: In The Line of Fire
programme.desc: Bombers, snipers, spree killers: some people don't care who they kill, they just want to hurt innocent people.

programme.title: The New Detectives: For Love Or Money
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When money is the motive, murder can rip at the very foundation of marriage and family.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Kahurangi Gold
programme.desc: If you're looking for quintessential New Zealand fly fishing, look no further than the Kahurangi National Park. The rivers are crystal clear, remote, and stacked with trophy brown trout.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Opening Weekend
programme.desc: Two words more magical to the ears of a fly fisher than 'Opening Weekend'? In New Zealand's South Island, the red letter day is the last day in September.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: West Coast Explorer
programme.desc: Good mates Ronan Creane and Jeff Forsee head off on a mission to explore the myriad of trout fishing options available on the beautiful West Coast of NZ's South Island.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: East Cape Raft Mission
programme.desc: NZ fly fishing champion Cory Scott and his good mate Chris Sharland venture deep into the East Cape for a challenging but ultimately rewarding multi-day rafting trip.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Willow Grubbers
programme.desc: Rene Vaz and Mike Wilkinson head into the deep south during the peak of summer in the hope that the famously large brown trout of the region will have begun feeding heavily on willow grubs.

programme.title: IFISH: Daly River, Northern Territory
programme.desc: When I asked Shane Compain to pick the best day of the year for myself and the IFISH Team to come smack some serious barramundi - he did not disappoint!

programme.title: IFISH: Hinchinbrook Region, Queensland
programme.desc: It's not often that you go fishing somewhere so picturesque, so pristine and so untouched that you seriously think to yourself "I wouldn't even care if I didn't get a bite"... but then you absolutely SMACK IT TOO!

programme.title: IFISH: ATA Lodge, Alagnak River, Alaska - Part 2
programme.desc: When Paul says he guarantee's you won't be disappointed, he ain't lying! Landing monster mutilated hook-jaw zombie chum salmon on fly, while bears patrol the banks, fishing around you. It's gotta be seen to be believed!

programme.title: IFISH: Alexandra, Victoria

programme.title: IFISH: Cullen Bay, Northern Territory
programme.desc: When life gives you lemons - make lemonade. When life gets you down - get back up. When life gives you dead flat seas, 40 degree heat, a sounder lit up like a Christmas tree and 1 hour left of fishing - make great TV!

programme.title: IFISH: Mornington, Victoria
programme.desc: There's nothing quite like getting back to basics and garfish off the local pier - that's what I love! Learn all the tricks, to ensure you too can grab a feed down your local and even cook them up like a Master Chef!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Mackenzie Country Canal Trout - Part 1
programme.desc: Angler Anto Hall teams up with Charles Smith for a mission into the Mackenzie Country in search of a canal monster. The team soon learn that fly fishing for these giant fish can be pretty darn tricky!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Mackenzie Country Canal Trout - Part 2
programme.desc: The team fish into the darkness and battle plummeting temperatures as they chase an an elusive 30lb+ monster in the Mackenzie Country canals.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: North Island Tiki Tour
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince go on a campervan tour of some of the North Island's best back country trout fishing. There's action aplenty, and as usual with these two characters, a lot of laughs!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Fiordland Mouse Trout
programme.desc: We join Anto Hall and Nick Geddes as they search the remote lakes of Fiordland for the mysterious 'mouse feeding trout' and Anto manages to catch the largest brown trout of his life!

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: The Mighty Tongariro
programme.desc: Fly fishing couple Hannah Clement and Tom Hodge hit the Tongariro during the winter spawning run of rainbow trout from Lake Taupo.

programme.title: The Hills: Drama Follows Them
programme.desc: Stephanie bliver uvenner med sin bror og hans ven da Lauren møder Spencer på sin fødselsdag. Kelly Cutrone fyrer en fra People's Revolution og Whitney overtager stillingen. Laurens forhold til Doug udvikler sig lidt for hurtigt.

programme.title: The Hills: Better Off As Friends
programme.desc: Lauren indser at den kemi, hun havde med Doug på studiet ikke længere er der. Whitney er nervøs for at tage til New York, men en date med en model gør hende gladere. Til trods for forsoningsgestusen vil Spencer bryde helt med Stephanie.

programme.title: The Hills: Boys Make Girls Cry
programme.desc: En vild tur til Las Vegas går galt, da Audrina ignorerer Lauren. Brody nævner Stephanies fortid, og drengene ryger i brummen. Heidis søster Holly flytter ind, men det er intet Spencer hellere vil end at smide hende ud.

programme.title: The Hills: Something Has To Change
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina kæmper for at redde deres venskab, men det kan allerede være for sent. Spencer har fået nok af Heidis søster Holly og tager sagen i egne hænder. Og Brody og Doug forlader fængslet med nye historier.

programme.title: The Hills: You Always Miss a Best Friend
programme.desc: Heidis søster Holly tager kontakt med Lauren, noget som tvinger både Lauren og Heidi til at revurdere hvad der er sket med dere venskab.. Audrina og Justins forhold bliver sat på prøve, da hun arbejder på en event for Epic Records.
programme.sub-title: You Always Miss a Best Friend

programme.title: The Hills: When Lauren's Away...
programme.desc: Da Lauren tager på ferie med familien, går alting galt i Los Angeles. Stephanie dater Doug bag Laurens rygg, og Audrina og Heidi bliver venner.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Act Innocent
programme.desc: Sandheden om Stephanies forhold til Laurens eks Doug kommer frem, da de alle mødes til Dougs poolparty. Heidis mor kommer overraskende på besøg til LA og ryger ud i en konfrontation med Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: If She Never Met Spencer...
programme.desc: Lauren får et brev fra Heidi, hvor hun beklager og indser, at der kun er én ting, som forhindrer dem i at blive venner igen. Audrina starter med at date en ny fyr for at gøre Justin jaloux, men hendes plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Who To Choose?
programme.desc: Audrina møder sin gamle flamme Corey igen og jonglerer pludselig to fyre. Spencer tvinger Heidi til at smide sin søster Holly ud af lejligheden.

programme.title: The Hills: You'll Never Have This
programme.desc: Lauren og Audrina rejser til Cabo til Brody fødselsdag, men da Justin bliver jaloux på Audrinas nye forhold, udvikler festen sig til en slåskamp. Spencer ydmyger Stephanie da hun finder ud af, at hendes nye kæreste er ven med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I Want You To Be With Me
programme.desc: Lauren prøver at skabe fred mellem Brody og Stephanie. Audrina vil få tingene til at fungere med Corey, men Justin vil ikke give slip på hende. Stephanie tvivler på sin nye kæreste, da han bryder sit løfte om at konfrontere Brody.
programme.sub-title: I Want You To Be With Me

programme.title: The Hills: It's Her Move
programme.desc: Audrina får sit eget sted, og håber, at Justin vil flytte ind hos hende, men alle frygter, at hun flytter af den forkerte grund. Heidi inviterer Spencer til et arrangement med arbejdet og bliver taget i at have det lidt for sjovt.

programme.title: The Hills: Back To New York
programme.desc: Whitney tager til New York i forventning om at møde Alex igen, men en ny fyr ved navn Jay fanger hendes opmærksomhed. Heidi er ulykkelig efter fyringen, men da Spencer taler med Brent for at skaffe hende jobbet tilbage, forværrer han situationen.

programme.title: The Hills: One Last Chance
programme.desc: Lauren lader Heidis søster overnatte. Justin inviterer Audrina med på en romantisk weekend, og Heidis frustration med Spencer vokser, da hun må tigge for at få sit job tilbage.

programme.title: The Hills: You Did This
programme.desc: Audrina tror på et rygte, hun hører: at Lauren har kysset med Justin. I mellemtiden prøver Holly at få Heidi væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: It's About Trust
programme.desc: Audrina forsøger at redde sit venskab med Lauren efter at have anklaget hende for at have kysset med Justin. Spencer og Stephanie besøger deres bedstemore, som er træt af, at de skændes.

programme.title: The Hills: Dream Boy, Dream Job
programme.desc: Whitney bliver tilbudt en chance for a score sit drømmejob NYC og håber at se Jay der. Lauren bliver nostalgisk, da hendes forældre sælger huset i Laguna Beach, og Stephanie går til Spencer for at få hjælp med Cameron.

programme.title: The Hills: Mr. & Mrs. Pratt
programme.desc: Spencer og Heidi ignorerer deres bekymrede familier og stikker af til Mexico for at blive gift. Whitney går efter drømmejobbet i New York City, og siger farvel til Lauren og sit liv i Los Angeles.

programme.title: The Hills: I Heidi Take Thee Spencer
programme.desc: Lauren og Heidi mødes og husker, hvorfor de plejede at være venner. Spencer og Heidi er lige blevet gift, da Heidis mor kommer til byen. Justin chokerer Audrina, da han tager hende med til Palm Springs til en overraskelse.

programme.title: The Hills: Don't Cry On Your Birthday
programme.desc: Da Heidi kommer uanmeldt til Laurens fødselsdagsfest, græder de to gamle venner over deres ødelagte venskab. Spencer kommer op at slås, da Cameron beskylder ham for at samle en bartender op.

programme.title: The Hills: Everything Happens for a Reason
programme.desc: Spencers flirtende opførsel får Heidi til at tage hjem til Colorado, hvor hun møder en gammel kæreste. Lauren skælder Stephanie ud for at have inviteret Heidi til festen. Spencer ender en lang stilhed med Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: I'm Done With You
programme.desc: Da Heidi overrasker Spencer på en natklub med bartenderen Stacie, forlanger hun, at de går i parterapi. Lauren risikerer sit rygte, da hun skaffer Stephanie en praktikplads hos People's Revolution.

programme.title: The Hills: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Audrina prøver at komme sig over Justin ved at gå efter Brody. Heidi slæber en modvillig Spencer med til parterapi. Da Stephanie kvajer sig hos People's Revolution, truer Lauren med at fyre hende.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Shelbie og Liv & Vanessa
programme.desc: Vennerne Shelbie & Liv har tager voldsomt på og trænger til at tabe sig. Vanessa drømmer om at få en krop som en kvindelig bryder. Kan de forvandle deres kroppe i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Mahan og Lydia
programme.desc: Pizzeria-ejeren Mahan har spist for meget dej og vil af med dellerne, mens Lydia vil have sin gamle krop tilbage. Kan de forvandle sig i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Body SOS: Sheena og Georgia
programme.desc: Sheena har brug for at tabe sig til sin bryllupsrejse, og Georgia vil tage sig for at blive, som hun var før. Kan de nå at ændre deres liv i tide til deres Ex on the Beach-afsløring?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Middagsdates med eks som tilbehør.
programme.desc: De single kendisser mødes til et poolparty og kaster sig ud i romantik. Men da terrortabletten siger, de skal have intime middagsdates, får de et chok over, at en eks ryger ud første aften.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Taget på sengen
programme.desc: Det er alt eller intet for Finn & Paige. Kendisserne fester på en strandklub, men Ashley kommer i tvivl om sit forhold til Jarred, og en stor kendis-ankomst tager Yaz på sengen.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Jeg er smuttet
programme.desc: Yaz, Chloe og Brockett får sig en snak. Finn og Paige har svært ved at bo sammen. En ny eks ryster et par ind til grunden.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Kærlighed med bump på vejen
programme.desc: Chloe, Veitch og Finn bliver tættere, og det er svært for Paige. Der er problemer i Yaz Chloe Brocketts venskab og en overraskende eks' ankomst truer med at ødelægge et par.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Løve-eksen
programme.desc: Chloe Veitch befinder i et trekantsdrama. Yaz Chloe Brockett venskab går fuldstændig galt, bådfesten bliver rystet af en eks på jetski, og tre kendisser bliver sendt på stranden, hvor den næste eks gemmer sig i mørket.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Aftenstranden
programme.desc: Kan Lockie og Yaz finde ud af at bo sammen? Chloe lægger alle sine æg i en kurv og en djævelsk flot kendis ryster villaen, men hvem ryger hjem nu?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Den eneste vej er eks
programme.desc: To ekser bliver elimineret, og James bliver knust. Yaz og Lockie prøver en sidste gang at slutte fred. En kendiseks laver ravage og villaen siger farvel til en OG.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Historien gentager sig
programme.desc: Jarred er frustreret og oprørt, Tamara føler, at historien kan gentage sig og Callum slår til.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Hænger i en tynd tråd
programme.desc: En ny kendis truer med at spolere et allerede skrøbeligt parforhold. Tamara kommer videre fra Joe og Paige er i et trekantsdrame mellem gammel og ny.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Flamme-ceremoni
programme.desc: Der er en chokeliminering, som ryster villaen. Paige må tage en kæmpestor beslutning, og den sidste aften bliver en tåreperser for kendisserne i en flammende ceremoni.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Kayleigh's Crisis
programme.desc: 'Ex on the Beach' er tilbage! Otte hotte singler får snart ødelagt alle tiders ferie, da en af deres ekser ankommer og ødelægger festen! Had, skænderier, tårer, drama, følelser og endnu flere ekser!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Love Triangles and Squares
programme.desc: Ankomsten af to ekser skaber kaos i villaen for alle, og det bliver kun værre. Rogans forhold til Anita går i stykker, når hans eks Jess ankommer på Dommedagsstranden. Mere kærlighed, mere had og vigtigst af alt flere ekser.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Secrets and Betrayals
programme.desc: Tre ekser i villaen betyder, at bølgerne går højt. Kayleigh bliver forrådt af sin ven Loren, der har kysset hendes eks Adam, og ankomsten af to ekser inkluderer et berømt ansigt, der dukker op af havet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: I'm Sorry, I'm a Prick
programme.desc: Fem ekser er i villaen og alle er anspændte efter ankomsten af Gaz fra Geordie Shore. Gary bager på Anita og de falder for hinanden. Men hendes eks dukker op af havet, og han knuste hendes hjerte. Imens har Adam en forfærdelig tid.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Star Gazing
programme.desc: Joes ankomst chokerer alle og Anita bliver helt ødelagt. Kayleigh skaber sig og fortæller Joe, at Anita har fjollet rundt med to af fyrene. Den næste eks er et velkendt ansigt som kan ødelægge det for Gaz og Anita. Velkommen Charlotte!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: The Gloves Are Off
programme.desc: Jess hører, at Rogan har kysset Megan og hævner sig ved at kysse hans bedste ven, Morgan. Bromancen ligger på is og villaen er nået smeltepunktet. Imens er Adam gået til Charlotte, og hun og Kayleigh skændes vildt.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Girl Code
programme.desc: Op af havet kommer et kendt ansigt - Ash fra den første sæson af Ex on the Beach - og han vil skabe KAOS. Alle pigerne er vilde med ham, fyrene frygter op og når Ash henter Anita til en privat fest, bryder helvede løs og Gary går amok!

programme.title: Ex On The Beach: Anita's Almighty Meltdown
programme.desc: Det er næsten forbi, og nogle af ekserne slutter fred, men andre vil aldrig blive enige. Gruppen holder festmiddag og Anita får et sammenbrud, der overgår alle andre. Men hvem får et chok under den sidste tur til stranden?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US
programme.desc: 10 stjerner fra reality-tv og sociale medier tror, at de er på en sexet tropeferie, men paradiset forvandles til et mareridt, når deres ekser dukker op på stranden. Vil det tænde gamle flammer eller åbne gamle sår?

programme.desc: Jonathan forsøger at gøre det godt igen med Basit. Et par kommer tættere på hinanden mens andre forsøger at ændre på deres giftige datingadfærd.

programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 1

programme.sub-title: How Far Would You Go For Love? Part 2

programme.title: Are You The One?

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Surprise-gæster giver singlerne råd og indsigt i, hvad der skal til for at finde deres perfekte match. En afsløring i Sandhedsbåsen ændrer dynamikken i huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?
programme.desc: Will skal leve med konsekvenserne af at forsøge at holde fast i sit forhold til Courtney, mens han leder efter sit perfekte match. Huset slår sig løs og deler skjulte talenter.

programme.title: Are You The One?: You Were The One

programme.title: Awkward: Jenna Lives
programme.desc: En mærkelig stalker puster liv i Jennas selvmordshistorie. Jenna undrer sig over, om hendes omdømme afholder Matty fra at se hende som kærestemateriale.

programme.title: Awkward: Queen Bee-atches
programme.desc: Jenna omgås de lede piger, da hun hjælper med Palos Verdes' elite mor/datter velgørende organisation. Det bliver mere akavet, da hun støder ind i Matty og Jake.

programme.title: Awkward: Over My Dead Body
programme.desc: Jenna får rollen som offer i en event om spirituskørsel. Hun kæmper med rollen, mens Jake og Matty kæmper om hendes opmærksomhed.

programme.title: Awkward: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch
programme.desc: Da Laceys BFF Ally kommer til byen beslutter de at 'hjælpe' Jenna med at drikke sig stiv. Næste dag har en glemsom Jenna tømmermænd og kæmper med at huske den vilde aften og hvem hun kyssede.
programme.sub-title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

programme.title: Awkward: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
programme.desc: Jenna får en pinlig 16-års fødselsdag og må håndtere følgerne af alle dem, hun har skubbet væk. Efter hun dumper køreprøven, undrer hun sig over, om hun kan reparere forholdet til Matty og Tamara.

programme.title: Awkward: No Doubt
programme.desc: Matty inviterer Jenna ud på deres første rigtige date. Men en afsløring får Jenna til at tvivle på alt ved sin romance med Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: I Am Jenna Hamilton
programme.desc: Romantik er i luften, og alle er begejstrede for Winter Formal. Selvom Jenna længes efter den store spørger, forsøger hun ikke at lade Matty's afslappede holdning skuffe hende.

programme.title: Awkward: Fateful
programme.desc: Jenna må endelig bestemme sig mellem Jake og Matty. Tamaras kærlighedsliv tager en overraskende drejning. Ming bringer en uventet date, og mysteriet bag pleje-frontation-brevet afsløres.

programme.title: Awkward: Resolutions
programme.desc: Jenna undgår at beskæftige sig med afsløringen af, at hendes mor skrev konfrontationsbrevet. I stedet spreder hun julehumør og nytårsstemning, indtil Jakes gave tvinger hende til at beslutte, om hun er klar til at glemme Matty helt.

programme.title: Awkward: Sex, Lies and the Sanctuary
programme.desc: Jenna nyder, at forholdet med Jake endelig er blevet officielt, indtil hun hører om de seneste måneders skjulte kameraoptagelser fra Sanctuary. Hun går derefter ekstremt til værks - og hverver bl.a. Ming - for ødelægge båndet.

programme.title: Awkward: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Jenna prøver at slutte fred med Matty og behage Jake, men har svært ved at ignorere Mattys evindelige flirten og klæbrige opførsel. Hans handlinger får hende til at stille spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem der egentligt er problemet i trioen.

programme.title: Awkward: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna er stadig ikke kommet sig over sine forældres separation og føler sig ansvarlig. I et impulsivt forsøg på at tilgive sig selv søger hun tilflugt fra sine problemer hos de højere magter i den religiøse lejrskole.
programme.sub-title: Are You There God? It's Me, Jenna

programme.title: Awkward: My Love is a Black Heart
programme.desc: Jenna forbereder sig på sin første Valentinsdag med en kæreste, men både hun og Tamara bliver jaloux, da det går op for dem, at deres ekskærester måske er ved at være klar til at komme videre med deres liv og glemme dem.
programme.sub-title: My Love is a Black Heart

programme.title: Awkward: What Comes First: Sex or Love?
programme.desc: Jenna har stadig ikke genfundet sit fodfæste efter Jakes kærlighedserklæring, og hun overvejer, om det at have sex med ham vil give hende klarhed om sine egne følelser.
programme.sub-title: What Comes First: Sex or Love?

programme.title: Awkward: Another one Bites the Dust
programme.desc: Jenna er klar til at have sex med Jake efter endelig at have fået klarhed over sine følelser. Hendes beslutsomhed bliver imidlertid grundigt testet af tante Allys bryllup, en mand fra hendes mors fortid og en intrigant Sadie.

programme.title: Awkward: Time After Time
programme.desc: Dårlig timing og afsløringer efterlader både Jenna og Jake knuste.

programme.title: Awkward: Homewrecker Hamilton
programme.desc: Jenna har svært ved at rede trådene ud i sit forskruede kærlighedsliv efter brud og genforeninger med drengene - lige indtil en uventet tekst placerer hendes dramatiske liv lige midt i rampelyset.

programme.title: Awkward: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me
programme.desc: Efter Jennas udgivelse af sin blog har alle pludselig en mening om hendes liv. Mens alle andre følger med for underholdningens skyld, kræver Jake og Matty svar.
programme.sub-title: Pick Me, Choose Me, Love Me

programme.title: Awkward: Once Upon a Blog
programme.desc: Jennas fantasi løber af med hende, og hun omdanner sin blog til en fiktiv fortælling i et forsøg på at ændre sin skæbne. Ved at undersøge og forestille sig en anden udgave af sin fortid forsøger Jenna at gennemskue fremtiden.

programme.title: Awkward: The Other Shoe
programme.desc: Jennas beslutning om drengene når ud til alle. Læg dertil en tur til Europa, og alt ser ud til at gå godt for Jenna. Der sker imidlertid noget, der får Jenna til at betvivle, om det at få alt det, hun ønsker, er det, hun har brug for.

programme.title: Awkward: Cha-Cha-Cha-Changes
programme.desc: Tredje år på high school byder på overraskelser og forandringer, der kan ændre hele Jennas fremtid.

programme.title: Awkward: Responsibly Irresponsible
programme.desc: En klassekammerats død får Jenna til at tænke over tab og sorg, og hun tager ansvar for den hemmelighed, hun skjuler fra Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: A Little Less Conversation
programme.desc: Matty virker fjern, da han hører, at Jenna tror, hun er gravid, men Jenna vil næsten gøre alt for ikke at tage 'snakken'.

programme.title: Awkward: Let's Talk About Sex
programme.desc: Jennas far gør selv noget ved sagen og taler med Mattys forældre om deres børns forhold.

programme.title: Awkward: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: Da Matty flytter ind hos Hamiltons indser Jenna, at hun har fået mere med i købet end hun havde håbet på.

programme.title: Awkward: That Girl Strikes Again
programme.desc: Spøgelserne fra Jennas fortid, og Jennas egen usikkerhed, melder sig på banen da det bliver Halloween i Palos Hills.

programme.title: Awkward: Guilt Trippin'
programme.desc: Jenna's første date til Homecoming-festen vækker skyldige minder om den pige, hun plejede at være og om de piger, der ikke har en date.

programme.title: Awkward: Rubbed Raw and Reeling
programme.desc: En udfordring fra Mr. Hart tvinger Jenna til at blotte sig selv se nogle svære afsløringer om sig selv i øjnene.

programme.title: Awkward: Reality Check
programme.desc: Efter at have taget en kop kaffe med Collin en sen aften kan Jenna ikke holde op med at tænke på ham og på, hvad det vil sige både at være småforelsket og at have en kæreste.

programme.title: Awkward: Redefining Jenna
programme.desc: Gnidningerne vokser mellem Jenna og Matty, da Collin inviterer hende til en smart fotografi-udstilling hjemme hos ham.

programme.title: Awkward: Surprise!
programme.desc: Efter at have været sammen med Collin beslutter Jenna sig for at holde op med at være utro før Matty finder ud af det.

programme.title: Awkward: And Then What Happened
programme.desc: Hvad skete der til surprisefesten - og er det virkelig helt slut mellem Jenna og Matty? Det ved kun de to, men deres venner forsøger at finde ud af sandheden.

programme.title: Awkward: Taking Sides
programme.desc: Jenna holder grillfest så hendes venner kan vænne sig til tanken om hendes og Collins spirende forhold. Men da deres støtte udebliver, tager hun drastiske midler i brug.

programme.title: Awkward: The Bad Seed
programme.desc: Efter at være blevet uvenner med Tamara og Ming, synes Jenna ikke at det spiller nogen rolle hvad hun gør længere - og det kaster hende ud i en vanskelig situation.

programme.title: Awkward: A Very Special Episode of Awkward
programme.desc: Val beder Mr Harts klasse om at skrive og fremføre et skuespil, og moralen i historien virker bekendt.
programme.sub-title: A Very Special Episode of Awkward

programme.title: Awkward: Less Than Hero
programme.desc: Efterdønningerne etter Jennas skænderi med vennerne får hende til at gå i byen. Men det som skulle blive en afslappende aften bliver en aften, hun skal reddes fra.

programme.title: Awkward: The Campaign Fail
programme.desc: Det er på tide for Jenna at komme på ret spor igen, men hun har forårsaget mere skade for sine nærmeste en hun kan rette op med med lidt PR. Vil de tilgive hende, eller må hun tage drastiske midler brug?

programme.title: Awkward: Old Jenna
programme.desc: Jenna og pigerne er gode venner igen og Jenna mener, at hun er klar til at genoptage forholdet til Matty.

programme.title: Awkward: Karmic Relief
programme.desc: Jenna håber, at hvis hun retter op på sine fejl ved at hjælpe Val med at få sit job tilbage, vil universet belønne hende med at sørge for, at hun og Matty finder sammen igen.

programme.title: Awkward: Who I Want To Be
programme.desc: Jenna bliver udfordret til at sætte spørgsmålstegn ved, hvem hun vil være i den episke sæsonfinale.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Efter Cady har boet i Afrika, aner hun intet om, hvor 'vilde' ting kan blive i civilisationen, indtil hun møder den ondeste art 'Queen Bee', der på denne skole er den kølige og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Efter Cady har boet i Afrika, aner hun intet om, hvor 'vilde' ting kan blive i civilisationen, indtil hun møder den ondeste art 'Queen Bee', der på denne skole er den kølige og kalkulerende Regina George.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: I denne skandaløse parodi på Paranormal Activity-filmene, The Devil Inside og andre found footage-film, hjemsøges et ungt par som netop er flyttet ind i deres drømmehus. Kort tid efter flytningen opdager de, at de ikke er alene.

programme.title: Barely Lethal
programme.desc: 16-årige Megan Walsh er i træning til at blive en international lejemorder, men hun længes efter at være en normal teenager. Hun forfalsker derfor sin egen død og indskriver sig på et gymnasium, men gymnasielivet kræver sin egen overlevelsesteknik.

programme.title: Faces In The Crowd
programme.desc: Milla Jovovich spiller Anna, den eneste kvinde, der har overlevet en grufuld seriemorders angreb. Men overfaldet efterlader Anna med en sjælden sygdom, der gør at hun ikke længere kan genkende ansigter.

programme.title: Philomena
programme.desc: En livstræt politisk journalist opsnapper historien om en mors søgen efter sin søn, som blev taget fra hende for flere årtier siden, da hun blev gravid og tvunget til at bo i et kloster.

programme.title: Modern Persuasion
programme.desc: En singlekvinde med fokus på karrieren i New York bliver tvunget til at forholde sig til følgerne af et forlist forhold, da hendes ekskæreste hyrer hendes firma. En moderne udgave af Jane Austens roman ”Kærlighed og svaghed”.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Da den håbløse romantiker Wallace møder Chantry, har de kemi med det samme. Der er bare ét problem: hun har en kæreste. De beslutter sig for at ses som venner, men det bliver sværere og sværere at holde venskabet og de voksende følelser adskilt.

programme.title: Down To You
programme.desc: Fra det øjeblik de mødes i universitetets kaos i New York City, begynder Al (Freddie Prinze Jr.) og Imogen (Julia Stiles) deres romantiske rejse, hvor ægte kærlighed ofte konkurrer med fristelsen til at vige fra engagementet.

programme.title: Watching the Detectives
programme.desc: Neil er en rigtig filmnørd, som ejer en lille videobutik. Når han ikke sidder fastklistret foran fjernsynet og en eller anden film noir, diskuterer han film med sine to medarbejdere, supernørden Lucien og den noget stabilere Jonathan.

programme.title: The Sentinel
programme.desc: Secret Service agenten Pete Garrison kommer påsporet af en forræder i Det hvide Hus, men bliver selvmistænkt og må bevise sin uskyld - inden det er forsent.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City
programme.desc: Velkommen til Sin City - byen, som tiltrækker de seje, de korrupte og dem med et knust hjerte. Nogle kalder den mørk og hårdkogt, mens skurkagtige betjente, sexede kvinder og desperate selvtægtsmænd kalder den for deres hjem.

programme.title: The Hunter
programme.desc: Steve McQueens sidste film understreger den storslåede skuespillers dynamiske talent i en af hans mest mindeværdige roller, som den moderne dusørjæger Ralph "Papa" Thorson.

programme.title: Jungle
programme.desc: Daniel Radcliffe kæmper mod naturens brutale kræfter og sit eget sind, da han forsøger at overleve i Bolivias nådesløse jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Hired Gun
programme.desc: When three people were found murdered in their home, it appeared like a burglary gone awry. But a crime this horrific deserved a closer look.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Cat and Mouse
programme.desc: He was a predator, abducting girls and young women from their own front yards in broad daylight. He was a sadist: phoning one victim's family, taunting them, boosting then dashing their hope, and he wouldn't stop until we stopped him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.
programme.sub-title: The True Story of Mississippi Burning

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Too often, convicted felons learn new techniques and find new partners in prison. In 1982, a group of former inmates began a spree of kidnapping and robbery.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: From California to Kentucky, few living near a railroad felt safe in the summer of 1999. A serial killer, rode the rails, picking towns and victims at random. He left behind a trail of bloodshed, but no trace of where he would turn up next.

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårdtarbejdende mor tager sine børn med på et udfordrende road trip efter hendes mands svigt.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: Animeret film med GEORGE CLOONEY og MERYL STREEP som Mr. og Mrs. Fox, der leveret lykkeligt familieliv med den excentriske søn(JASON SCHWARTZMAN) og nevøen Kristofferson,som er på besøg.

programme.title: A Merry Holiday
programme.desc: Christy, en meget succesfuld sælger, stresser over at få en stor handel. For at hjælpe hende skal hun slå sig sammen med Jonathan, der har travlt med at skabe en magisk jul til sin kæreste. Konflikten er givet, men noget andet begynder også at gry...

programme.title: Demain tout commence
programme.desc: Samuel nyder et sorgløst liv på Den Franske Riviera, indtil Kristin, som han har haft en kortvarig affære med, meddeler, at han er far til et nyfødt barn, overlader en lille pige til ham og stikker af!

programme.title: About Hope
programme.desc: Thomas McKenzie har ledt efter den perfekte kvinde i hele sit liv. Da han møder to kvinder, som vækker hans interesse, går det op for ham, at den kærlighed, vi søger, ikke altid er den kærlighed, vi har brug for.

programme.title: P.S.
programme.desc: En nyligt skilt kvinde får muligheden for at genopleve sin fortid, da hun møder en ung mand, der tilsyneladende er hendes gymnasie kæreste, der døde mange år tidligere.

programme.title: Bare Juliet
programme.desc: Annie (Rose Byrne) er kørt træt i sit parforhold med Duncan (Chris O'Dowd), der er kæmpefan af musikeren Tucker Crowe (Ethan Hawke). Da en demoversion af Tuckers gamle hit LP dukker op, bliver det starten på et nyt møde med den flyvske kunstner.

programme.title: Fårfejden
programme.desc: Colin og Les opdrætter prisvindende får på en gård i et lille australsk samfund. Da en sygdom spreder sig blandt dyrene, og myndighederne beslutter, at alle fårene i dalen skal aflives, må mændene arbejde sammen for at redde deres levebrød.

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia: Raymond Edmunds
programme.desc: In 1966, two teenagers Garry Heywood and Abina Madill went missing in Shepparton, Victoria. Their bodies were found days later. The murders would remain unsolved for over two decades when a chance discovery of a set of fingerprints to connect the murders

programme.title: Crimes That Shook Australia: Patricia Byers

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A pretty graduate student, leading a secret double life as a sex worker, begins a relationship with a dangerous drifter. Paul Winfield narrates.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The Mile High City is rocked by the death of high-rolling multimillionaire Lawrence Ocrant. His death is ruled a suicide.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: The murder of Stephen Harvey, one of Kansas City's most promising young jazz musicians, and the acquittal of his suspected killer outraged the city and nearly led to rioting.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: One of the wealthiest doctors in Arkansas finds trouble when she meets a ruthless con man who convinces her to give him more that a million dollars. Narrated by Paul Winfield.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: An eccentric city commissioner, famed for his wild outbursts at commission meetings, is suspected of brutally beating an immunology professor and his wife.

programme.title: City Confidential
programme.desc: A Kentucky river town is shocked when the owner of a popular restaurant is bludgeoned to death with an antique pancake syrup bottle and her husband is charged.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Efren Saldivar
programme.desc: Efren Saldivar confessed to killing 40 to 50 patients over an eight-year period. Quickly christened an "Angel of Death," he targeted patients who were already near death.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Karen Pedley
programme.desc: The case of care home worker Karen Pedley who was given 14 life sentences in 2016. Deeply affected by a fire at her home when she was a child, Pedley developed into a pyromaniac.

programme.title: The Legend of Korra: The Last Stand
programme.desc: The fate of the Earth Kingdom and the Avatar's life is at stake, when Korra comes face to face with Kuvira.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Boy in the Iceberg
programme.desc: When a young waterbender, named Katara, and her brother, Sokka, discover a giant iceberg while fishing for food around their homestead at the South Pole, they discover that there is a boy, named Aang, inside.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar Returns
programme.desc: After Aang accidentally sets off a Fire Nation trap, he is banished from the South Pole. Soon after Prince Zuko attacks the Southern Water Tribe seeking to capture the Avatar. Aang returns and surrenders to save the Water Tribe.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Southern Air Temple
programme.desc: Aang is eager to take Sokka and Katara to the Air Temple where he was raised. But upon arrival, it becomes apparent that the temple is not at all how Aang remembers it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Warriors of Kyoshi
programme.desc: As one of Aang's little detours, the group heads toward the island of Kyoshi. But soon they learn that the townspeople don't trust foreigners at all; however, when Aang proves to them that he is the Avatar they are treated as guests of honor.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The King of Omashu
programme.desc: Aang takes Katara and Sokka back to a favorite place he used to go to when he was younger, the Earth Kingdom City of Omashu. But when they break the law they are taken to the King to get their punishment.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Imprisoned
programme.desc: The kids come to an Earth Nation town which is occupied by the Fire Nation. But will Katara's attempts to inspire the oppressed people help them or hurt them?

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka arrive at a town being terrorized by a mysterious force from the spirit world. Aang doesn't know how to help these people, and realizes he has much to learn about being the Avatar.
programme.sub-title: Winter Solstice Part 1: The Spirit World

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Winter Solstice Part 2: Avatar Roku
programme.desc: During the winter solstice, Aang must reach a Fire Nation temple while dodging Prince Zuko, Commander Zhao, and the Fire Sages who guard it.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Scroll
programme.desc: After Katara attempts to teach Aang waterbending, she is desperate to improve her abilities.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Jet
programme.desc: While traveling towards the North Pole, the group almost gets captured by the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Great Divide
programme.desc: When Aang and friends come to the rim of a giant canyon, they are asked to help guide two groups of refugees across.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Storm
programme.desc: A powerful storm brings up painful memories of the past - and puts everyone in jeopardy in the present.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blue Spirit
programme.desc: After Sokka and Katara get sick due to being in the storm, Aang seeks out a cure and discovers he needs some frozen frogs in order to get them cured.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Fortuneteller
programme.desc: Aang, Katara, and Sokka discover a village of people who are all reliant on a fortuneteller in their everyday lives - but they are so reliant that they are blind to the immanent danger they are all in.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bato of the Water Tribe
programme.desc: Aang feels insecure when Katara and Sokka come across something that reminds them of home. Because Aang thinks his friends might leave him, he hides an important message which only leads to trouble.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Deserter
programme.desc: Aang attempts to find a Firebending master to teach him while Katara learns that she possesses a special power.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Northern Air Temple
programme.desc: After hearing rumors about surviving Airbenders, the kids journey to the Northern Air temple to see for themselves. What they find there could spell disaster for all enemies of the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Waterbending Master
programme.desc: The kids reach the Northern Water tribe, and Aang and Katara look for a Waterbending Master as Sokka falls for a princess. Meanwhile, Zhao plans an attack and Zuko must find a way to continue his quest for the Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 1
programme.desc: The Northern Water Tribe braces itself for an attack by Admiral Zhao's Fire Navy fleet. In the heat of battle, Aang struggles to defend the city. He wonders if there isn't a better way to use his Avatar abilities.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 1

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Siege of the North Part 2
programme.desc: Zhao's invasion breaks through the outer wall of the Northern Water Tribe's defenses, and he reveals a sinister plan.
programme.sub-title: The Siege of the North Part 2

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Avatar State
programme.desc: Aang and the group meet an Earth Kingdom general who wants to use Aang's powerful "Avatar State" as a weapon to defeat the Fire Nation. But getting into the "Avatar state" on purpose is more difficult than Aang thinks.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Cave of Two Lovers
programme.desc: On their way to Omashu, the kids meet a group of nomads who show them a short cut through the 'cave of two lovers'.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Return to Omashu
programme.desc: The kids return to Omashu so that Aang can learn Earthbending from King Bumi. But when they get there, they are shocked to find the city is now in Fire Nation hands. Despite the danger, Aang enters Omashu in search of King Bumi.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Swamp
programme.desc: When the kids end up in a mysterious and strange swamp, their fears are exposed. And Aang learns about being "connected to the Earth" from an unlikely teacher.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Avatar Day
programme.desc: Aang must clear up a wave of anti-Avatar sentiment and atone for something he did in the past.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Blind Bandit
programme.desc: In search for an Earthbending teacher for Aang, the kids go to an underground Earthbending tournament where they encounter Toph, a blind, but powerful Earthbender.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Zuko Alone
programme.desc: Traveling without Uncle now, Zuko wanders alone into an Earth Kingdom town where he bonds with a local boy. Meanwhile, Zuko is haunted by memories of his own youth.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: As the kids are pursued relentlessly by a mysterious machine, their exhaustion puts them at each other's throats.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Bitter Work
programme.desc: When Aang struggles with a block while trying to learn Earthbending from Toph, he wonders if the problem is with him or his teacher. Meanwhile, Sokka gets himself in a jam.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Library
programme.desc: A professor leads the kids to a spirit library in the middle of the desert, where Sokka hopes to discover powerful secrets to use against the Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Desert
programme.desc: Aang searches for Appa, while Katara struggles to keep everyone together so they can survive in the vast desert. Meanwhile, Uncle and Zuko seek help from an ancient secret society.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Serpent's Pass
programme.desc: The group then huddles around the map to discuss in which direction they should go - the Serpent's Pass appears to be the most direct route.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: The Drill
programme.desc: Aang discovers a secret Fire Nation super weapon heading straight for Ba Sing Se and must stop it before it destroys the great wall that protects the city from invasion.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: City of Walls and Secrets
programme.desc: Aang and the kids finally arrive in Ba Sing Se to see the Earth King, only to find mysterious forces within the city conspiring to stop them. Meanwhile, Jet tries to find proof that Zuko and Uncle are Fire Nation.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender: Tales of Ba Sing Se
